items.description: All URIs must point to records of type `dev.tsunagite.game`.

game.description: The game(s) this song is included in.

genre.description: The genre this song belongs to.

title.description: The human-readable title of this song in UI. Translations will typically be listed alongside the default.

jacket.description: The jacket or banner art of this song, for display in UI.

source.description: The source this song is from - an album, competition, other game, etc.

composer.description: The name of the composer of this song. Translations will typically be listed alongside the default.

subtitle.description: The human-readable subtitle of this song.

jacketArtist.description: The name of the jacket artist for this song.

main.description: A song included in a game hosting leaderboards via Tsunagite.

schema.description: Definitions related to songs included in games hosting leaderboards via Tsunagite.
